from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-rnd0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u055/system/state/workspace/programs/task-b2212554.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 3]
    top = min(r for r, c in cells)
    bottom = max(r for r, c in cells)
    left = min(c for r, c in cells)
    right = max(c for r, c in cells)
    seeds = [(r, c) for r, c in cells if top < r < bottom and left < c < right]
    sr, sc = seeds[0]
    for r in range(top + 1, bottom):
        for c in range(left + 1, right):
            d = max(abs(r - sr), abs(c - sc))
            out[r][c] = 3 if d == 0 else (4 if d % 2 else 2)
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source,str(p),'exec'), globals())
